Mitsui Chemicals.why: Makes pellicles and is building CNT pellicle capacity for next-generation EUV lithography, plus ICROS Tape semiconductor process tape; its ICT Solutions segment grows with cutting-edge semiconductor demand driven by generative AI.
Mitsui Chemicals.evidence: Mitsui Chemicals Q1 FY2026 earnings slides (08-05-2026): 'Production facilities for CNT pellicles for use in next-gen EUV lithography @Japan October.'26 5,000 sheets'; semiconductor applications increased due to growing demand in cutting-edge applications driven by the expansion of generative AI.

players.product: EUV pellicles (incl. CNT pellicles for next-generation EUV lithography) and ICROS Tape semiconductor process tape

quarterly_data.signal: Company (Q1 FY2026 briefing Q&A): for the CNT pellicle for EUV lithography, pilot operation of the new plant has begun and customer evaluations of pilot products are progressing smoothly; Q2 factors in higher fixed costs including CNT pellicle start-up costs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Chemicals earnings call Q&A summary: Q1 FY2026 Earnings Conference Call (08-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: sales of pellicles remained firm, with Q1 (April to June) sales revenue increasing by slightly less than 20% both year on year and compared with the previous quarter; ICROS Tape volume rose approximately 20% quarter on quarter in Q1, and the company expects volume up approximately 10% year on year in both Q1 and Q2.
quarterly_data.figure: Pellicle sales revenue up slightly less than 20% YoY and QoQ; ICROS Tape volume approx. 20% QoQ
